enchantments.tooltip: Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +40 (Equipment bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Tira's Splendor: Any weapon you wield becomes able to bypass silver damage reduction.
Embodiment of Law: Chaotic aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
Rune Arm Imbue: Light IV: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d6 points of light damage per hit.
This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.
